description: This PHP class 'FormatWithLicenseId' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a formatted string representation of a license entity based on its ID. It interacts with the 'LicenseService' to fetch license details and returns the license name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithLicenseId
classes.description: A formatter class that retrieves a license's name by its ID using LicenseService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the license name associated with the given entity value (license ID), or null if not found.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LicenseService.
